summary: Moved the two double sockets onto the kitchen-facing island side panel and relocated washer and dryer sockets to the rear wall behind their stacked appliances. Fixed first-person collision from room-wide clipped wall finishes.

E1_005_SOCKET.purpose: Kitchen island double socket for blender, mixer and kettle
E1_005_SOCKET.installation_detail: Double socket flush to the kitchen-facing side panel of the island, just below the worktop, for blender/mixer and kettle. Keep leads on the island side and away from the sink and hob.

E1_006_SOCKET.purpose: Kitchen island double socket for small appliances and spare use
E1_006_SOCKET.installation_detail: Second double socket flush to the kitchen-facing side panel of the island, just below the worktop, for mixer/blender and other small appliances.

E1_022_SOCKET.purpose: Concealed rear-wall supply for the washing machine in the laundry stack
E1_022_SOCKET.installation_detail: Rear wall behind the washer, with cable routed behind the appliance. Leave the recess and plug depth required by the selected washer; confirm manufacturer instructions and a side-accessible isolation arrangement.

E1_023_SOCKET.purpose: Concealed rear-wall supply for the dryer above the washing machine
E1_023_SOCKET.installation_detail: Rear wall behind the dryer, with cable routed behind the stack. Leave the recess and plug depth required by the selected dryer and stacking kit; confirm manufacturer instructions and side access for service.

installation_notes: Kitchen outlets are on the island side panel just below the worktop and labeled for small appliances.
Washer and dryer outlets are behind the stacked appliance column; leave the recess/plug depth required by the selected units and stacking kit.
All electrical locations remain proposals, not as-built verification.
